note: Early check, Wednesday. The moneylines look sharp, and Ortega-Hooker already sits where the read puts it, so I'm not betting a winner. The one price wrong for a reason I can name is Aliskerov by decision. His last two wins were wrestling-control decisions: he held Park and his previous opponent down for six and nine minutes. Since 2019 Cannonier has been stopped once in his last eight fights against top opponents (Imavov, R4); his other losses all went to the cards. Small, because a 42-year-old's chin can go at any time and Aliskerov hits hard in the first round.

picks.reasoning: Aliskerov by decision at +190: ours 38% against FanDuel's 30%. He wins by control, not by finishing durable opponents. Cannonier almost always goes the distance in defeat: of his losses since 2019, only Imavov (R4) stopped him. Aliskerov's power early and Cannonier's age are the risks, hence $1, under the $1.15 quarter-Kelly guide.
